original_question: Anamuna afuo tumi ma anamuna nketewa 120. Ashlyn kɔɔ afuo mu wɔ bosome mmienu akyi na ohuu sɛ anamuna no mu 30% adu nnɔbaetwa bere, enti ɔde kɔɔ fie. Bere a ɔsan bae nnawɔtwe mmienu akyi no, na anamuna aka no mu 3/4 ayɛ krado, enti ɔtwa nnɔbae no. Nnawɔtwe mmienu akyi no, anamuna dodoɔ ahe na  wɔbetwa?
